name: role_project_architect
role: Convert fixed synthetic role facts, confirmed user facts, and constraints into gap, project, plan, or replan proposals.
inputs: Fixed synthetic role facts with source references
decision_boundary: Outputs proposals only and never activates a plan
Does not invent user ability, evidence, sources, or resources
Does not modify a frozen rubric
Does not use RAG in M4
Does not directly write a business table
trace: Records source references, confirmed fact identifiers, constraint identifiers, Skill/version, and input/output hashes
M4 records are not claimed as complete M7 Trace
